items: invariant 1: sum of the known balances equals the total supply
invariant 2: the zero address never holds tokens
invariant 3: a call the contract rejects changes nothing
invariant 4: supply changes only through an accepted mint, burn or burnFrom
invariant 5: an accepted transfer / transferFrom moves exactly amount between the right accounts (nothing for a self-transfer)
invariant 6: approve sets, increaseAllowance adds and decreaseAllowance subtracts the allowance exactly
invariant 7: an accepted transferFrom / burnFrom reduces the allowance by exactly amount
invariant 8: an accepted mint raises supply and the recipient's balance by exactly amount
invariant 9: an accepted burn lowers supply and the burner's balance by exactly amount
